title: Construct and relax Os-alloy supercells
action: Build 2×2 supercells of pristine MX₂ monolayers (M=Mo,W; X=S,Se,Te) and replace one M atom with Os to form M₀.₇₅Os₀.₂₅X₂. Relax atomic positions using DFT (PBE, spin-orbit coupling) until forces converge.
description: Intermediate relaxation step producing optimized alloy structures for subsequent band structure calculations.

title: Compute band gaps for all alloys
action: For each relaxed alloy, compute the band structure with DFT (PBE, SOC) and extract the global (indirect) band gap and the direct band gap at the band-inversion point. Write the results to band_gaps.csv.
description: CSV file containing the computed global and direct nontrivial gaps for all six Os-alloyed systems.
output_schema: CSV with columns: system (string), global_gap_meV (float or 'metallic'), direct_gap_meV (float or 'metallic')

title: Compute strain-dependent gaps for Mo₀.₇₅Os₀.₂₅Te₂
action: For the relaxed Mo₀.₇₅Os₀.₂₅Te₂ structure, apply biaxial strain from -2% to +4% in 1% steps. For each strain, compute the band structure with DFT (PBE, SOC) and extract the direct nontrivial band gap. Write the results to strain_gaps.csv.
description: CSV file containing the direct band gap as a function of biaxial strain for Mo₀.₇₅Os₀.₂₅Te₂.
